title: Homologous PRP vs Placebo in Knee Osteoarthritis in Over 65 Years Old Patients
official: Homologous PRP Versus Placebo in the Infiltrative Treatment of Knee Osteoarthritis in Over 65 Years Old Patients.
summary: The aim of the study is to compare the 6 months clinical outcome of the treatment with a single injection of Homologous PRP versus single injection of placebo (saline solution) in the infiltrative treatment of knee osteoarthritis in over 65 years old patients. The evaluation will be performed through clinical, subjective and objective assessments.
